const axios = require('axios')
const cheerio = require('cheerio')

class Chords {
  constructor(music) {
    this.searchUri = \`https://www.gitagram.com/index.php?cat=&s=${encodeURIComponent(music)}\`
  }

  async getSearch() {
    try {
      const { data } = await axios.get(this.searchUri)
      const $ = cheerio.load(data)

      let results = []

      $('table.table tbody tr').each((i, el) => {
        let title = $(el).find('span.title.is-6').text().trim()
        let artist = $(el).find('span.subtitle.is-6').text().replace('&#8227; ', '').trim()
        let link = $(el).find('a').attr('href')
        let type = $(el).find('span.title.is-7').text().trim()

        results.push({
          title,
          artist,
          link,
          type
        })
      })

      return {
        code: 200,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        results
      }
    } catch (e) {
      return {
        code: 500,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        message: e.message
      }
    }
  }

  async getDetail(uri) {
    try {
      const { data } = await axios.get(uri)
      const $ = cheerio.load(data)

      let title = $('h1.title.is-5').text().trim()
      let artist = $('div.subheader a span.subtitle').text().replace('‣', '').trim()
      let artistProfileLink = $('div.subheader a').attr('href')
      let artistImage = $('figure.image img').attr('src')
      let date = $('span.icon-text span').text().trim()

      let chords = []
      $('div.content pre').each((i, el) => {
        chords.push($(el).text().trim())
      })

      let formattedChords = chords.join('\n')
        .replace(/\\n/g, '\n')

      return {
        code: 200,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        result: {
          title,
          artist,
          artistProfileLink: artistProfileLink ? \`https://www.gitagram.com${artistProfileLink}\` : '',
          artistImage,
          date,
          chords: formattedChords
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      return {
        code: 500,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        message: e.message
      }
    }
  }
}

;(async () => {
  const client = new Chords('Hindia')
  return await client.getSearch()
})()
